# Noelle Winters

Noelle Winters is a pop artist from Toronto, Canada. This page is her official artist hub: releases, track lists, cover art and listen links.

## Artist

- Name: Noelle Winters
- Genre: Pop
- Based in: Toronto, Canada
- Official site: https://gshakir79-dot.github.io/noellewinters/
- Listen (DistroKid HyperFollow): https://distrokid.com/hyperfollow/noellewinters/noelle-winters

## Discography

### Noelle Winters — Debut EP (released November 11, 2026)
Track list:
1. Wishlist — the EP's holiday lead track, timed for the Christmas season
2. Made In The Six — a Toronto anthem ("the Six" is Toronto's nickname)
3. Golden Hour
4. Second Wind
5. Lucky Charm
